description: This file contains utility functions for distributed tensor operations in PyTorch, including broadcasting, reducing, scattering, and gathering tensors across multiple GPUs, with specific focus on communication primitives like NCCL.

methods.name: broadcast
methods.description: Broadcasts a tensor to specified GPU devices, either returning copies on each device or storing in provided output tensors.

methods.name: broadcast_coalesced
methods.description: Broadcasts a sequence of tensors to multiple GPUs, coalescing small tensors into a buffer to optimize synchronization.

methods.name: reduce_add
methods.description: Sums tensors from multiple GPUs, ensuring they are on the same device and have matching sizes.

methods.name: reduce_add_coalesced
methods.description: Performs a coalesced sum of tensors from multiple GPUs, handling sparse and dense tensors efficiently.

methods.name: scatter
methods.description: Distributes a tensor across multiple GPUs along a specified dimension.

methods.name: gather
methods.description: Concatenates tensors from multiple GPUs into a single tensor on a specified device.
